questions.q: What did Solomon ask God for at Gibeon?
questions.evidence: Now give me wisdom and knowledge, that I may go out and come in before this people

questions.q: On which mountain did Solomon build Yahweh's house?
questions.evidence: Then Solomon began to build Yahweh’s house at Jerusalem on Mount Moriah, where Yahweh appeared to David his father, which he prepared in the place that David had appointed, on the threshing floor of Ornan the Jebusite

questions.q: When Solomon finished praying, what came down from heaven?
questions.evidence: Now when Solomon had finished praying, fire came down from heaven and consumed the burnt offering and the sacrifices

questions.q: If his people humble themselves, pray and turn, what will God do for their land?
options: Raise up a king in it
questions.evidence: then I will hear from heaven, will forgive their sin, and will heal their land

questions.q: Where did all Israel gather to make Rehoboam king?
What did the teachers Jehoshaphat sent take with them through Judah?
questions.evidence: They taught in Judah, having the book of Yahweh’s law with them

questions.q: Whom did Jehoshaphat appoint to go out before the army?
questions.evidence: When he had taken counsel with the people, he appointed those who were to sing to Yahweh, and give praise in holy array, as they go out before the army, and say, “Give thanks to Yahweh

questions.q: How old was Joash when he began to reign?
questions.evidence: Joash was seven years old when he began to reign, and he reigned forty years in Jerusalem

questions.q: Which king was struck with leprosy while he held a censer to burn incense?
questions.evidence: Then Uzziah was angry. He had a censer in his hand to burn incense, and while he was angry with the priests, the leprosy broke out on his forehead before the priests in Yahweh’s house, beside the altar of incense

questions.q: Which prophet prayed with Hezekiah when the king of Assyria came?
questions.evidence: Hezekiah the king and Isaiah the prophet the son of Amoz, prayed because of this, and cried to heaven

questions.q: Which king humbled himself and prayed after being carried to Babylon in chains?
questions.evidence: Therefore Yahweh brought on them the captains of the army of the king of Assyria, who took Manasseh in chains, bound him with fetters, and carried him to Babylon

questions.q: Which king of Persia proclaimed that God's house would be built in Jerusalem?
questions.evidence: Yahweh stirred up the spirit of Cyrus king of Persia, so that he made a proclamation throughout all his kingdom
